Trace, implement and test: 02.08.Linked List Cycle

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    ListNode* detectCycle(ListNode* head) {
        ListNode* fast = head;
        ListNode* slow = head;
        while (fast && fast->next) {
            slow = slow->next;
            fast = fast->next->next;
            if (slow == fast) {
                ListNode* ans = head;
                while (ans != slow) {
                    ans = ans->next;
                    slow = slow->next;
                }
                return ans;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }
};
